notes.title: [0.0.93] In-Game Wiki, and fun QOL changes!
notes.content:
The new update brings a fun in-game wiki, entries in the in-game wiki are unlockable through defeating the enemies you are trying to look up!

QOL Changes:
[list]
[*] The player when logging in is now shown walking in the map they were last logged in at
[*] The loading screen is now set to show the map the player is entering
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] The leaderboard bug from 0.0.92 has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.9 Update - New Area, Enemies, and Gear
notes.content: This new area features new enemies that can drop new gear as well as a rarer more expensive version of that gear (very rare though)

notes.title: Movement patch thoroughly tested and works!
notes.content:
I apologize for the movement patch mishap, there seemed to be a bug that came with that patch that needed fixing, and after thorough testing you can now move while attacking enemies again!

Thank you to all the early access players that are contributing ideas and helpful feedback!

notes.title: 0.0.84a - Potion Witch NPC and Golem Balancing
notes.content:
In this update, there is a new NPC in town, the Potion Witch and Golem

[b]Potion Witch[/b]
[list]
[*]allows you to purchase maximum potion upgrades that scale with your level, unlocked every 5 EXP levels gained.
[/list]

[b]Golem Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]After various feedback on the Golems attack and my own experience of being stuck at golems (fighting them while typing this), their attack has been decreased to 24.
[/list]
